title: The non-abelian Leopoldt conjecture and equalities of $\mathcal{L}$-invariants
summary: Let $G$ be a reductive group quasi-split at $p$. Using arguments of Hansen--Thorne, we show that under the non-abelian Leopoldt conjecture (NALC), Hansen's $p$-adic overconvergent cohomology eigenvariety for $G$ is étale over its image in weight space at any non-critical classical tempered cuspidal point of `cohomological multiplicity one'. This applies to all non-critical classical cuspidal points if $G = \mathrm{Res}_{F/\mathbb{Q}}\mathrm{GL}_n$.
